title: The pressure at the Titanic's depth
caption:
3,800 metres down, the ocean pushes with almost 400 kg on every square centimetre. That's a grand piano on your fingertip. 🌊
Full video: [LINK]
Would you ever dive that deep?
sources: NOAA Ocean Service, How does pressure change with ocean depth?; Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution, Alvin; Wikipedia, Titan submersible implosion
